title: Private Outdoor Escape Room - Find a Spy in Los Angeles
includes: Devious story interspersed with silly jokes
Find an undercover spy walking through Little Tokyo
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The experience is designed for 1-4 players. (1 ticket must be purchased for each person). We can accommodate up to 6 players. If you have more than 6 players, please buy two adjoining timeslots.
We recommend ages 12 and up. Younger kids are welcome to participate and can help solve clues and search for the spy. Children under 7 can join for free.
policies: All players will need a smartphone with a US number that can receive texts, calls and has access to the internet to play this game.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Los Angeles's charming Little Tokyo neighborhood while searching for an undercover spy wandering the area!

Experience silly jokes, a devious plot, fun puzzles, and big thrills as you navigate through all the popular areas and secret corners of Little Tokyo.
